AMD.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
AMD.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of December, so fiscal quarters line up with calendar quarters (FY2026 Q1 = Jan-Mar 2026).

NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year ends in late January and is named for the calendar year it ends in. FY2027 = Feb 2026-Jan 2027, so FY2027 Q1 = Feb-Apr 2026.

APLD.name: Applied Digital Corporation
APLD.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year ends May 31 and is named for the calendar year it ends in. FY2026 = Jun 2025-May 2026, so FY2026 Q1 = Jun-Aug 2025.
